name: Jerry Velasco
office: City of El Monte, City Clerk

items.text: Jerry Velasco previously served on the El Monte City Council as Mayor Pro Tem and City Treasurer, and currently works as an entertainment producer. He also serves on the Los Angeles County Commission on Alcohol and Other Drugs. According to 2020 city council minutes, he helped initiate a COVID-19 testing center at the El Monte Airport.

sentences.text: Jerry Velasco previously served on the El Monte City Council as Mayor Pro Tem and City Treasurer, and currently works as an entertainment producer.
He also serves on the Los Angeles County Commission on Alcohol and Other Drugs.
According to 2020 city council minutes, he helped initiate a COVID-19 testing center at the El Monte Airport.

items.text: In a 2026 questionnaire, Velasco noted the city clerk does not make policy but can offer recommendations. He said he would recommend giving developers incentives to build affordable housing. Velasco said he would make spending public promptly and encourage residents to attend council meetings. He wants to beautify the city and attract businesses by partnering with developers and seeking state and federal funding.
